name: Law of Foundation & Identity
meaning: If foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do? Foundations represent core spiritual covenants, altars, and ancestral patterns. In Christ, believers have a new foundation as kings and priests.
dreamClues: Old family house, crumbling foundation, digging, childhood home, broken pillars.
deliveranceAction: Renounce ancestral covenants and proclaim your position seated with Christ in heavenly places (Eph 2:6).

name: Law of Legal Rights
meaning: The adversary requires legal ground (unforgiveness, hidden sin, occult participation, or covenants) to afflict or torment. The blood of Jesus wipes away every handwriting of requirements.
dreamClues: Courtrooms, police arrest, being pursued and caught, locked gates, legal documents, theft.
deliveranceAction: Repent thoroughly, forgive all offenders, revoke every ungodly covenant, and plead the blood of Jesus.

name: Altars & Territorial Spirits
meaning: Altars are spiritual landing points that enforce spiritual patterns. Evil ancestral or territorial altars enforce delay, poverty, or marital stagnation. Godly altars of prayer, praise, and Communion dismantle them.
dreamClues: Shrines, masquerades, village meetings, sacrifices, strange priests, idols, ancient trees.
deliveranceAction: Raise the altar of the Cross, take holy Communion, and decree the destruction of idolatrous ancestral altars.

name: Law of Marine / Water Spirits Discernment
meaning: In African deliverance ministry, water spirits represent spirits of seduction, pride, delays, and marital turbulence. Note: direct KJV teaches God's sovereignty over the deep and chaos, while marine spirit theology is an interpretive deliverance framework.
dreamClues: Dirty water, drowning, strange snakes in water, seductive water encounters, rivers with crocodiles.
deliveranceAction: Renounce any marine covenants or dedications. Command every water-based embargo to break in Jesus' name.

name: Law of Agreement
meaning: Can two walk together except they be agreed? Spiritual agreement gives authority. Agreement with fear, defeat, or ungodly suggestions invites oppression.
dreamClues: Signing documents, shaking hands with shadowy figures, eating at strange banquets, saying yes to strangers.
deliveranceAction: Nullify any dream-induced agreements, contracts, or evil handshakes by the power of the blood of Jesus.

name: Law of the Tongue & Seeds
meaning: Death and life are in the power of the tongue. Spoken words and dream declarations are spiritual seeds that yield after their kind.
dreamClues: Mouth sewn shut, seeds, planting, harvest, eating bitter fruit, speaking curses.
deliveranceAction: Uproot negative self-confessions and decrees spoken over your destiny. Decree God's promises boldly.

name: Law of Household Authority
meaning: Spiritual authority and generational patterns operate through family proximity and bloodlines. Deliverance breaks generational cycles of hardship.
dreamClues: Family compound, deceased relatives speaking, parents' old belongings, sibling disputes.
deliveranceAction: Stand in the gap for your household. Decree that ancestral yokes stop at your generation.

name: Law of Spiritual Blindness
meaning: The enemy attempts to blind believers to God's divine purpose and spiritual direction. God's light brings illumination and clarity.
dreamClues: Blindfolds, dark rooms, lost spectacles, thick fog, inability to read Scripture.
deliveranceAction: Pray: 'Lord, open my eyes that I may behold wondrous things out of Your law.' Anoint your eyes with spiritual discernment.

name: Law of the Stumbling Block
meaning: A trap or temptation designed to cause spiritual compromise, sexual fall, or offense. It often looks like a shortcut or attractive gift.
dreamClues: Pit, concealed wire, seductive stranger, counterfeit gold, delicious poisoned food.
deliveranceAction: Ask God for holy discernment. Avoid spiritual shortcuts and walk in uncompromising righteousness.

name: Law of Peace & Divine Flow
meaning: Peace is the spiritual umpire. The Holy Spirit's guidance produces supernatural peace and clarity, while enemy attacks bring turmoil and confusion.
dreamClues: Still waters, green pastures, gentle breezes, radiant morning sun, clear pathways.
deliveranceAction: Follow the peace of God. Rest in His divine provision and reject anxiety.
